title: Cobble Legends Adventures
description: This modpack is based on Cobblemon and RPG-style mods to make it more challenging, where you and your Pokémon have to level up.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4d0412a27cdf5e84075cf292546d25cbff9ef25.png)


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/WFRF3RL6LBc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

COBBLE LEGENDS ADVENTURES is a complete Cobblemon-based experience designed for players who want to combine creature capturing with RPG mechanics, deep exploration, and FUN challenges.

This modpack transforms the Minecraft world into a living, content-rich adventure

🌀 Main Features

Cobblemon as the base

Full creature capturing and training system.

Improved AI and biomes filled with varied spawns.

Compatibility with Cobblemon expansions and addons.

🟠 🏰 Exploration and Dungeons

New world-generated structures.

Dungeons with special loot.

Dangerous underground areas.

🟢 ⚔️ RPG Focus

Leveling, skills, and progression systems.

Improvements to melee and ranged combat.

Rare gear, relics, and epic loot.

🔵 🌟 Legendaries

Balanced and fair legendary spawns.

Search mechanics that encourage exploration and strategy.

🎮 Why download this modpack?

If you like Cobblemon but want a world with more life, more challenges, and more progression, this modpack is made for you.
It combines creature capturing + adventure + RPG + epic exploration, without losing performance or playability.

Perfect for series, streaming, survival worlds, and private servers.
